# BLES.JK — house coverage rates it BUY

Signal: the South Research division published coverage (v1) with a 12-month target of Rp413.0 against Rp194.0 (expected total return 117.0%). Why now: the rating crossed the BUY band on the engine's probability-weighted target.

Archetype guess: derated_compounder_rerating · method card: per fund record routing for Cement & building materials.

Sharpest questions for a thesis:
- Section 4 derives COE 13.2% from rf 7.4%, ERP 4.2%, CRP 2.5% and beta 1.10; those inputs give 14.5% (7.4 + 1.10*4.2 + 2.5) or 14.8% (7.4 + 1.10*6.7). The model's coc block reproduces exactly rf + beta*(ERP+CRP) - 0.0162 
- The capex basis and section 3 say the 2026 plan is 'only about Rp70bn (trucks and solar panels)' citing [S10]. S10 is a 7.2k-character June 2026 FY2025-results article: it has no 2026 capex figure, no trucks and no solar
- The bear prices in price -8% (Rp446k), volume -7% and GM -3pp, yet its own narrative says distributors push price back 'toward the 2025 level' (Rp411k, -15%) and the verified FY2025 gross margin was 25.9%, 14pp below the

Regime stance vs the macro desk is UNASSESSED: IDEATION/CONSTRUCT sets WITH / NEUTRAL / AGAINST before any deep-dive. Fast-disqualify checks and the thesis itself follow the full analyst -> Bear -> Judge law.
